purpose: Benchmark-only evidence for industrial heat, services heating, household cooking and fossil-fuel processing. No observation in this file is a model constraint.

unit_conversions.natural_gas_conversion_basis: Existing v33 full-precision conversion: 1036 Btu/scf and 1055.05585262 J/Btu.

industry_final_energy.source_locator: Philippine Energy Plan 2020-2040, Table 73, 2020 levels and percent shares.
industry_final_energy.boundary_note: Whole-industry final energy, including motive power and non-heat electricity. It is not a process-heat-only balance and is therefore diagnostic against the model's industrial heat routes.

services_final_energy.boundary_note: Whole-services final energy, not heating-only energy. It is therefore diagnostic against the model's services-heating routes.

household_primary_cooking_fuel.source_locator: PSA Household Characteristics, 2020 CPH, paragraph 11 and Figure 4.
household_primary_cooking_fuel.boundary_note: Share of households reporting the fuel used most of the time for cooking, not cooking energy or useful-service share. The same observation informed the v23 cooking proxy and initial-stock mix, so it is not independent validation.

oil_refining.source_locator: 2020 Philippine Energy Situationer, Transformation, Oil Refining, Figure 12.
oil_refining.boundary_note: Domestic refinery output. The model oil-processing route also carries the aggregate imported-oil supply pool and therefore is not an aligned refinery-only result.

natural_gas.source_locator: DOE Natural Gas Development Plan, 2020 narrative and natural-gas consumption/production table.
natural_gas.boundary_note: National delivered natural-gas consumption; aligned with output of the model's national natural-gas processing route in 2020, before LNG imports.

coal.source_locator: Philippine Energy Plan 2020-2040, Table 11 and surrounding 2020 coal-consumption text.
coal.boundary_note: National coal consumption across power and industry; aligned with output of the model's national coal-processing route.

psa_cooking.title: Household Characteristics (2020 Census of Population and Housing)

doe_situationer_2020.title: 2020 Philippine Energy Situationer and Key Energy Statistics

doe_pep_2020_2040.title: Philippine Energy Plan 2020-2040
doe_pep_2020_2040.source_type: Primary national energy plan and historical tables

research_limitations: No national 2020 process-heat-only fuel balance was located for industry.
No national 2020 heating-only fuel balance was located for services.
No nationally representative 2020 cooking-energy-by-fuel table with device efficiencies was located; PSA reports primary household fuel instead.

The legacy DOE PDF URLs were discoverable and their indexed tables/text were checked, but direct byte retrieval was unavailable during this research pass; this normalized extract preserves the exact values and locators used.
